caption: The drawing features two detailed illustrations of decorative bracelets, each centrally placed against a plain, off-white background. Both bracelets are composed of intricately woven or braided brown bands. The top bracelet has a central metallic clasp with three sections: the left section is oval and lightly textured in gold, the middle section is round and silvery with a fine mesh pattern, and the right section is rectangular and decorated with floral-like engravings in silver. The second bracelet, located below the first, also features a central clasp but this one is more uniform in design and predominantly gold-colored, with a large central oval shape and rectangular flanking sections, all with engraved details. Below the lower bracelet, the name "Marion H. Gaskill." is written in light blue handwriting. The composition keeps both objects horizontally aligned and separated by empty space, with no additional background elements or colors.
title: Bracelet
